items.title: Can Balen bring India and China together on climate cooperation?
items.summary: In the aftermath of the catastrophic Rasuwa-Gyirong flash flood, Prime Minister Balendra Shah proposed that Nepal, India and China work together to address climate-related disasters in the Himalayas. items.title: Nepal has failed disaster survivors before. Can Bhotekoshi be different?
items.summary: Past relocation schemes have left families in unsafe settlements or driven them home. A 55-year-old settlement in Kanchanpur offers lessons as the government plans to relocate Bhotekoshi flood survivors.

items.title: Months after Bhotekoshi floods, families still await bodies and closure
items.summary: DNA matches alone cannot establish which missing family member the recovered remains belong to, and this has delayed identification and the return of bodies.

items.title: Lack of verified data delays scholarships for flood-hit students
items.summary: Nearly three months after the Bhotekoshi catastrophe, the government has approved scholarships for 27 students, but the number of other children who lost their parents or homes remains unknown.
